_comment: F22#4 / BOSSES §4.11: Captain Nerissa's Heart Chamber side-channel sweeps. Channel Cycle runs while Cannonback and Mirejaw fight; Pressure Rise begins with Riverdrake (the third send-out). Riptusk (Break Tether) fights without sweeps. Driven by scripts/world/water_nerissa_channels.gd in the process that runs the battle (the host when the host fights); remote participants get the hit through the encounter's host_deliver_enemy_hit and the lane state through WaterVeilfallTransport. Only creatures are struck; the trainer never is. No durable state. OFF until its unit tests, the C2 named-fight check and the in-world three-judge round pass.

phases._why: BOSSES §4.11 numbers, exactly. send_outs are 0-based roster indices.

_why_damage: BOSSES §4.11: 10% of the struck creature's maximum HP, once per wave.
_why_escape: BOSSES §4.11: if a creature at 5.6 m/s cannot leave the announced lane during the complete tell from its current legal position, that wave deals no damage.
_why_gap: Not fixed by BOSSES: quiet time after a wave drains before the next announce may begin (also waits out any creature tell). TUNABLE.
_why_first_wave_delay: Not fixed by BOSSES: each send-out fights alone this long before the first sweep, so the entry beat is never covered. TUNABLE.

lane._why: Not fixed by BOSSES beyond 'at least half the 42x44 m Heart Chamber remains safe'. Lanes run the chamber's long axis (z) as strips beside the fight ring's centre, measured in room-local metres from that centre: [inner, outer] offsets along x. Each lane covers under a third of the ring, so far more than half stays safe. TUNABLE.

_why_first_side_rule: Not fixed by BOSSES: Channel Cycle announces on the side the piloted creature is on ('ally'), so a sweep always asks for a move; Pressure Rise then alternates. TUNABLE.

presentation._why: Shallow water sheets along the side channel: a pale shimmer while announced, a raised bright surge while active, then fading. Presentation only.
